avis.texte: Honestly this is a huge part of my routine at night. It leaves my skin feeling dewy and hydrated. The texture at first I wasn't sure of but honestly this is now my favorite product

I have been a loyal buyer of Naturium products for several years, and lately their quality control has been unacceptable. Their retinols smell strongly of mold, their bottles are shipped with no lids, and this product arrived completely unmixed. It was like sticky taffy swimming in water or oil. I will keep purchasing the products that are currently working, but I fear the brand may be going in a horrible direction.
Excellent cream for tretinoin users who are prone to breakouts! Please make this in a jumbo!

avis.titre: Horrible texture and leaves me greasy
avis.texte: I gve this a good try, but had to throw it away. The texture is so so bad. It glides around my face and doesnt feel like it actaully sinks into my skin. I have to rub it in for so long to get it to absorb. In the morning my skin is super greasy after using it.
There are better products that don't have the same kind of founder

I am obsessed with this cream!! Talk about hydrating and moisturizing. I'm on my second bottle and will continue to keep this on repeat as long that they don't change anything. The jar is even very nice and I was telling my husband that they should have some kind of program. Like send us your empty bottle in a prepaid box (like the one you get your new on in), and we will discount you 5$ on refill. Or something, the jar is just nice and I feel bad throwing it out.

I love this cream. Its so rich and hydrating and feels so luxurious. I actually bought it to replace a high end moisturizer I have and i love it more! The price point is great. This is super thick. I use this before bed rather than a daily moisturizer. Great for combination skin.

I like to use this as a night cream, over my Retinaldehyde Cream Serum 0.1%. It's rich, very hydrating and emollient. It seals everything in for the night. Some mention the smell and the dry down time, but I don't mind it. I prefer fragrance free skincare products, and since I use this at night I have time to let it sink in and dry down. Great formulation!
This cream is great for my neck, chest amd back of my hands. On my face it's moisturizing but too greasy. And i have crazy dry skin.

I bought this six months ago and gave it a good shot, taking breaks to make sure it was the problem - boy was it the problem. As some other folks have noted, terrible consistency, very sticky and tacky and doesn't seem to sink into the skin. The smell is a bit like mothballs, and every time I use it I have irritation and acne shortly after. Will dispose of the rest of this product and go back to the ceramide cream.
So far I'm loving it. The texture is odd but it melts into skin. I use on neck and decollate. Smell is odd but you get used to it.
This is the first moisturizer I've found that doesn't leave my face feeling dry after a few hours. It's super think but absorbs nicely. This will be a product I'll continue repurchasing.

avis.titre: Don't use if you have oily skin
avis.texte: I have oily skin so this product just broke me out due to how oily it is. Not sure if its a formulation issue or just my oily skin having a bad reaction but ive stopped usjg it and my skin has cleared up! Oily girls stay away from this!!

This is a step up from the peptide moisturizer. I was looking for a good cream, and after trying so many luxury/prestige brands, I came across the peptide moisturizer (absolutely loved it), so I figured why not try this as an evening cream. The peptide moisturizer and this cream both feel like a luxury product. I have combo skin (oily T-zone), and I love this as my last step before bed. My skin is so soft and more plump after using it! Truly a great product for a fraction of the cost as prestige brands.

avis.titre: I love how it feels but…
avis.texte: I love how this cream feels on my skin. However I cannot get over the smell. It stinks and I stopped using it because I don't like snelling it.

LOVE this rich moisturizer! Within my first use I can see a difference in my skin! My skin looked plump and texture was nice and even! And it helps calm my rosacea! If you can get past the strange smell it is amazing!

I just received my Multi-Peptide Rich Cream and product is separated. The cream thick part is swimming in what looks like water but feels oily. It also has a not no pleasant smell, almost rancid like. I dont think I should put this on my face.

Horrific burning. My skin on my face is wrecked now, it feels like wind burn. I have never been so disappointed in a product. I even have a couple blemishes and I am in my 50's and I never get blemishes. I even had to stop my trentenoin because it hurts so bad.

Really wanted a rich PM cream with peptides so had high hopes for this! While it met the criteria, the experience really fell short - don't feel like it absorbed well, if there was even the tiniest bit of dampness on my face post cleanse it would hardly absorb at all (water and oil feeling - assume it's oil based). Didn't interact well with other products either (again assuming because they were water based)

I wanted to love this product, and I did at first, I've only had it a couple of weeks and the texture has change and the smell as well. It's now watery and hard to mix together, and smells different than when I first opened it. I always go in with clean hands and it's stored in a cool dry environment with the lid completely closed. It definitely leaves a heavy feel on the skin, which I'm not always opposed to, but this feels a bit too occlusive and waxy for me.

This rich and creamy moisturizer was JUST the pick me up my skin! Just in one night of me using this product, my skin texture improved, my redness/ rosacea has diminished, and my fine lines have reduced significantly! 9.5/10

I bought this 2 weeks ago and WOW! I normally have dry sensitive skin that freaks out at any product being put on it. I felt like I needed a thicker moisturizer than I used before especially for the cold weather. Within the first 2 days of using it so much of my texture and all of my dryness went away. All of the irritation on my face was healed within the first week. The texture of this cream is so so wonderful when you put it on you think it would be almost a thicker balm type when when you start rubbing it in it just melts right into your face. My skin has never been so hydrated and comfortable before!! If it couldn't get any better it is so glowy my face always looks like I am fresh from a facial. 100% reccomend to anyone with the same skin type.
People who are saying this is thick and hard to spread— are you warming it between your fingers and patting it in (not rubbing)? Very moisturzing and glowy.

So off the bat as soon as you open it yes interesting scent, earthy I'd say, but not a deal breaker. First couple of uses I loved how thick and moisturizing it felt. Does it have that sticky, tacky feeling others mentioned yes- don't hit the pillow right away. One thing I dont like that others have also mentioned is its separating. I've tried mixing it to see if its a fluke but keeps happening. Debating on taking it back or keep giving it a chance.

When I think about the amount of money I have spent on products because they have had 4+ stars and they did absolutely nothing for me, iI get extremely annoyed. I am so glad I bought this product on a whim without knowing what people thought. I would have passed up on it! This is the first time that a product did exactly what it said it would do. I need to stop reading reviews!
I dont know how a moisturizer can feel dry but this one does. Its hard to rub in and feels like a dry clay mask. It also feels like it sits on top of my skin.

avis.titre: Difficult to use, especially if skin is damp
avis.texte: Oh, no, I don't like this. I wanted a richer cream for the winter, but I didn't want a cream that is difficult to apply. This cream is rich, but it is also stubborn. It does not spread easily and becomes patchy when I try to massage it into my skin. I much prefer applying skincare to damp skin and this becomes even more difficult to apply when skin is damp. It is difficult to describe, but it's unpleasant and takes too much time and effort to apply. I want my skincare to be easy and this is not. I like the way my skin looks and feels in the morning, so I will give it two stars for that, but I would not repurchase or recommend. Try the peptide serum under another moistuizer, instead!
It feels dry, I usually love naturium, but this feels dry when applied and I feel like I have to layer a bunch of serums under so it will even glide across my face.

This is my favorite night cream year round! I've lost track of how many jars I've gone through. I always wake up with my skin plump, dewy, and calm. I dab a little under my eyes too. Usually use this with the 0.2 retinal from geek and gorgeous with no problem. I think it smells like clay which I don't mind. That disappears as soon as it's rubbed in anyway.

I wasn't sure at first bc the texture seemed tacky but then when it's massaged into skin, it turns into the mist silky, luxurious cream that makes my skin feel smooth and very comfortable. I'll use at night and under makeup during day but might switch to something lighter for day in the summer. The ingredients are excellent!
Keeping this on restock every month has been a game changer in my skincare. It has the most glowy finish, and lasts all day!

I bought this as a winter moisturizer and it's perfect for what my skin needs in these cold months. I've used it for about a month now as a PM moisturizer. My skin is typically very dry in the winter and I've had no issues this year. It does have a bit of a weird smell but it's not noticeable once you've put it on.

I like their other products so I had high hopes for this but unfortunately it just isn'ta good product. Like the others have said, there isn't much product in the container. But my main complaint is it does not rub in well or glide across the skin like most lotions or creams. This one won't be bought again. Also has a weird smell.

Such a rich and luxurious texture, thick yet silky. It does not disappear into skin and feels more like an occlusive, which is exactly what my dry winter skin needs. I can feel it sealing in my serums underneath, and my skin feels so plump, comfortable and hydrated. LOVE IT!!

avis.titre: moisturizing & leaves my skin feeling hydrated
avis.texte: I was kind of hesitant to buy this at first because compared to all the other products that Naturium offers, this one does not have that many stars. I saw it on sale and decided to try it out and I am in love! This leaves my skin feeling so hydrated. I use this at night and when I wake up, my skin feels so moisturized and alive. My normal nighttime skin routine I will use the cleansing gelee, Naturium Multi‑Peptide Advanced Serum, my doctor prescribed tretinoin, the multipeptide eyecream, and the multi peptide moisiturizer last. I usually will rotate the tretinoin out with the retinaldehyde cream serum that naturium has since its not good to use them both since they are both vitamin a retinoids. I have been using Naturium and only naturium is 2023 except for products that they don't have such as a face mist (please make one🥹) or collagen masks (also please 🥹). So I tried this product for the first time replacing the final step of moisturizer with this product and I am amazed at how it is! I am wishing I tried this sooner! The next product on my list to try is the face cleansing oil that also is not as highly rated as the other products but now I am having high expectations for it.

avis.titre: Miracle Cream for Dry and Dull Skin
avis.texte: Made my Dry skin beautiful and glowy, feel so good and luxurious.

avis.titre: Not a rich cream, breaks into a thin watery lotion
avis.texte: This is probably one of the worst creams I've ever used. Calling it rich, is a farse. Sure, it feels thick and creamy when you take it out of the tub but within seconds of rubbing your hands together or rubbing the cream on your face there is a very distinct moment when the cream "breaks" and completely thins out to a super flimsy consistency like water. I absolutely hate it. I've tried it on bare skin, and over other serums… it does the same thing every time. Maybe you could call it a thin lotion but a rich cream??? Not even close.

avis.titre: A rich cream that is actually rich
avis.texte: This works SO WELL. It is actually rich and hydrating - perfect for cold months. It smells like linseed oil which I like. People complain about the smell but I find it comforting. Smells like the cream is working 🤣
Absolutely love this product! It leaves my skin so soft and has a beautiful glowy finish.

avis.titre: A treat for dry, aging skin
avis.texte: Got this a month ago, and already ordered a new one, planning to stock up as I don't live in the US. I have dry, starting to age skin. I have tried loads of trending moisturizers and always left me wanting to reapply mid day. This is a game changers for me. Yes, the smell is not great and read that is the normal smell of the ingredients, but now I associate the smell with rich hydration and comfy skin. This made my undereye not feel dry and improved my wrinkles. It can be patchy when first applied, but I noticed that once it warms up on the skin and especially if applied over the serum from the same line, is just a treat.

avis.titre: Feels expensive without the price tag
avis.texte: As a postmenopausal woman over the age of 50, I have trialed numerous premium topical formulations targeting age-related skin changes. This particular cream has demonstrated noticeable improvements in my complexion, including enhanced hydration, smoother texture, and increased radiance. Its efficacy appears to surpass that of other products I've used, suggesting a well-balanced formulation that supports skin barrier function and addresses hormonal shifts associated with menopause.
I love this cream. No smell, not to think not to light. Leaves my skin hydrated and glowing.

This stuff is a big nope for me. The product is so thick that its unpleasant to spread on your skin unless you put a serum down first; it feels like youre smearing spackle on your face. The smell is gross, it genuinely reminds me of wet cardboard. The moisturization aspect is okay I guess although it leaves your face greasy for some time. Definitely wont be repurchasing.
I am obsessed with this cream. I live near the mountains and it's getting drier and colder. This cream keeps me hydrated and glowy all day long.
This is a sleeper. Such a rich and deep moisture that comes from this product. My skin at night is always so moisturized. I live in Chicago so I love this product.
One of my absolute faves for over 50 skin. Really nice as a primver too!

Absolutely terrible! I live at 10k ft elevation so a rich moisturizer is essential. This is not it! Pastey, sticky, doesn't actually absorb into the skin just leaves this unpleasant film on top. Feels very waxy and not actually hydrating. Going back to my old tried and trues, will not be putting this on my skin again.

Not sure why this has low ratings. If you're a dry skin girlie you will LOVE this. It is very thick so better for the winter months. I use it year round because I love how glowy and smooth it makes my skin. The smell is kind of weird but it's unscented so I like it for my eczema prone skin.

I bought this multi-peptide rich cream a few months ago and started to use. I truly love this cream. It is rich but not greasy. Like the way it leaves my skin. I will purchase again and highly recommend it. Thank you for a great product
Obsessed, I love how this rich creamy moisturizer feels on my face and makes my skin looks so dewy and hydrated. Definitely a must have. The whole peptide is chefs kiss

I have neither oily or dry, acne free skin and this product broke me out in a weeks time. I usually apply my moisturizers on damp skin but this product seemed to sit on top of my skin instead of my skin absorbing it. I wanted this product to work out but I had to return it.
Multi-Peptide Rich Cream-This cream is amazing. It is luxurious on the skin. Way to go Naturium! Love it!
Cream quality is good but the smell is unpleasant to me.. smells like old Vaseline or something and the cream feels like it slips off the skin when applying
Extremely moisturizing for dry, aging skin. Works great as a primer during the day. Just incredible! Nothing compares!
LOVE! Makes my skin feel like silk. Hydrating and non greasy.
This moisturizer is decadent!! Love how this feels on my face. No issues with makeup either
So thick like a mask and odd odor, doesn't rub into skin well and is not like a moisturizer

I wanted to love this, but maybe I received an old or bad bottle. The color is much darker and it has an awful oil like smell. While it is super thick, it still melts into your skin easily. However, I only tested on my hand because I think the bottle I received is old.

I've been using this moisturizer for a couple months now to give it a real chance and I'm just not a fan. It's very thick, which looks like it would be moisturizing but it really just feels like it sticks and drags across the skin instead of sinking in and leaving the skin soft. And it has a really weird, almost musty scent to it. Not just unscented but it's kind of gross. I would pass on ordering.

Super hydrating luxurious feeling cream. It has almost a tacky like consistency but melts onto your face. I do wish the delivery system was different, but it seems like a great value for what you get.
My skin is already showing a difference in hydration the only thing I don't like is the smell when first applying but the smell does go away and your face feels so smooth and hydrated
This is a smelly, tacky moisturizer that has an uneven distribution. Not sure if I received a bad batch?

avis.titre: Mult peptide cream is a MUST in skin care routine
avis.texte: This formula is a richer fuller multi peptide cream which allows the skin to absorb a more concentrated amount of peptides which the skin so desperately craves. It provides deep moisturizing power and protection from the pollutants that flow freely and radically throughout the air. Love the multi peptide rich cream!
Incredible hydration! At first, the texture is a rich cream but the moment you start spreading it, it melts and feels almost light a serum. My skin just drinks it all up.
I was ok if it was no smell moisturizer, but it smells bad. I was not able to spread it nicely on my damp skin. It sticky after application. Returning this product after using it for one day.
My dry skin is at peace with this product. I put it on every night over a Prequel serum. I'm 54, and my skin is glowing! The texture is a little weird, but you get used to it.

This cream is pure indulgence. The rich, velvety texture melts beautifully into the skin, leaving it deeply nourished, smooth, and radiant. The advanced multi-peptide blend works wonders on fine lines, while the linseed extract delivers lasting hydration and a plump, youthful glow. Every application feels like a spa moment — an essential in my skincare ritual.

This is an AMAZING product! I'm 47 with combination skin. It is a thick cream so it's better to use at night but I am so happy with the results it's provided under my eyes. The skin under my eyes feels so much firmer! My skin overall feels and looks better & it did not take months or even a whole tub to see the results! This stuff is 🔥🔥🔥🔥

I purchased this cream after reading many labels, searching for something without acrylates. Acrylates are a liquid microplastic used in many skin beauty products, and a somewhat recently discovered allergen. Before trying Naturium Multi-peptide rich cream, my skin reacted so terribly to everything I tried, that my face was red and bumpy, covered in contact dermatitis. My skin barrier was destroyed, and I was feeling hopeless. One week of using this product and my skin is almost fully healed. My skin stays moisturized all day, the cream feels rich and heavy but doesn't cause me any break outs. My skin barrier is beginning to feel healthier, and my skin looks plump and hydrated again. What worked for me won't work for everyone, but I will 100% be repurchasing this product. I really hope this never gets discontinued or reformulated! Thank you Naturium for making a product without acrylates!!

Terrible smell! I could not wear this more than a few nights because the smell was awful. I would only recommend buying this if you have tried it and are okay with the smell. Also, be aware of their return policy, which is extremely limited and applies only to fully priced items price items.

My holy grail face cream please never change this formula! My face has never felt more moisturized in my life and I don't have to slug with Vaseline anymore. Also I know people have complaints about the smell but I don't find it off putting plus I rather that then it smelling like watermelon or something lol
I genuinely loved this moisturizer for my dry winter skin but it smells so bad that I can't bring myself to repurchase.
I bought this moisturizer cream and omg my dry skin drinks this up. Makes my skin super plump and dewy. I use it day and night however during the day I use a thin layer.

It moisturizes well, but it doesn't perform better than the other Naturium products I've used. It's very thick, so you have to use quite a bit of it, so in that way, it's more expensive than products which work just as well. If you have very dry skin, this would probably be great for you!

avis.titre: OMG you have to try this!
avis.texte: This is very thick and perfect for my very dry skin in NY. this is my new favorite cream!
OMG!! The absolute best product for winter skin! My skin soaks it right up. And looks and feels so plump and dewy.

avis.titre: Mixture separated making it look unappealing
avis.texte: Just received the product and even though I have not tried it on my face, upon opening my new cream...it was not mixed.The water and cream separated, so it was gloop-y watery mess. Kinda looked like white mud inside a puddle of water. Very weird. Very disappointing.

avis.titre: Sticky, tacky, occlusive, wax like finish
avis.texte: This is not suitable for acne prone skin, or skin that is even remotely oily. Sticky, tacky, does not dry down. Difficult to rub in, feels occlusive. Definitely not for use in summer months. I am experiencing a breakout after just two uses. The video and description say suitable for acne prone skin, feels a lot like it's geared toward marketing.

Too soon to notice any changes to my skin using this cream. It's definitely on the thicker side and not super easy to apply but great for the winter months. I use this in the evening after my actives. I feel like it may be too thick to wear during the day under makeup.

I bought this cream a few weeks ago to replace a different peptide cream. The Naturium cream was more affordable. This is THE most beautiful cream. It's lightweight and moisturizes so beautifully. My skin is so soft and supple because of it. I'm not going back to another peptide cream.
I really love this moisture rich cream.I have dry shin but this cream does wonders especially in this harsh winter here in New York
LOVE this moisturizer i had a damage skin barrier from over exfoliant and it was the only moisturizer that did not burn oddly. But it is also very hydrating and makeup lays good on top. Love it
Thick, moisturizing cream. Easily absorbs and keeps my skin hydrated.

I never tried the multi-peptide moisturizer, but this rich cream is amazingggg! I have oily skin but in the winter I peel and get very dry. I use this at night and sometimes in the mornings if I am not wearing makeup and have noticed a difference within a week. GET IT!

avis.titre: Exceptional product that melts into the skin
avis.texte: The cream is rich and leaves my face feeling wonderfully plump. A little goes a long way, melting seamlessly into the skin. This is an exceptional product with consistently outstanding results.

I have combo skin and during the winter it can get very dry. This cream has such a beautiful, unique, cushy texture that feels nourishing enough for cold dry winters. Peptides are just a plus, here and it definitely feels firming. I won't use it when summer comes around because it will be a little too much when it's warm but if you get dry winter skin or have dry skin in general this is perfect!

It's not a bad moisturizer! It's just not that impressive to me compared to the plant rich ceramide cream from Naturium. It just kinda feels thick but not necessarily emollient. I saw someone else describe it as vaseline-like texture somewhere but I'd say it's not thaaat thick. To help put it on, I saw a youtube video where someone said they "break it" first by warming it between their fingers and then the texture glides on better. If you're going to use this, I'd skip putting any glycolic acid underneath as it can mess with the peptides and also because the one time I didn't follow that rule and used the glycolic resurfacing gel underneath, the cream kind of separated weirdly on my skin. Overall, it's okay...it's got a plastic-y smell and kind of smells also like hot dogs and sunflower seeds...but it's maybe worth a shot. I'd still recommend the plant rich ceramide cream 1,000 times over.

Oh gosh I love this new product! It's so beautiful and nourishing! I use it at night and makes me feel like a queen 😍 it really works and it integrates really well with the rest of my products. It's delicious and most importantly, has no scent.

avis.titre: If you are sensitive to smell I wouldn't recommend
avis.texte: Unfortunately I did not love this cream due to the scent it has. Although it is fragrance free, to me it smelled very chemically. Their other moisturizer did not have a scent at all. The consistency is fine but I could not stand the scent. It lingered all day.

avis.titre: I HAVE FOUND THIS GEM THAT I WILL NVER GIVE UP
avis.texte: The most, moisturizer ever. Amazing. Rich, dense, but not heavy. Absorbs beautifully. But my skin feels like it is truly moisturized and just not sitting on the skin. I was using the ceramide rich cream. which is my top favorite. To bad the peptide cream and the ceramide cream can't have a baby....A little hint Naturium:) menopausal, dehydrated skin needs that extra umph. Some nights I use the peptide serum first, the the peptide cream and seal with the ceramide cream. NO actives, just a nice moisture rich night. The nights I use my tretinoin I alternate between the peptide cream and the ceramide cream. My skin loves Naturium moisturizes. Nourishing, effective and cost friendly. I don't think I can ever be without this moisturizer now that I have found.

avis.titre: Personally would not purchase this item again!
avis.texte: Terrible consistency. Does NOT blend well on skin. The smell is also quite nasty.

I had never tried the Multi Peptide Cream and this time I went for it, I'M OBSESSED!! I always use their Dew Glo SPF and Purple Ginseng Balm but I'm sooo excited to try everything else I got! Thank you @SusanYara for the amazing products! You and your team keep us looking youthful and our skin tells it all!!

I find the smell of this cream quite disgusting. To me it smells like lard or something similar. It also does not blend in well on the skin. I would have preferred if it had some fragrance over this nauseous smell.

I'm only on my second day using this and it's already changed the game. Skin is baby soft, my stubborn laugh line is PLUMP and barely noticeable, and I am glowing. My husband just asked me if I was wearing makeup. I just woke up and have nothing on my face. I am an oily skinned girlie and this feels more like a sleeping cream for me. And no way could I wear it during the day. Just keep that in mind. I am torn because I love the original moisturizer too and I don't know how I will keep or use both! This is a problem! Aaah! But also…BUY THIS NOW!

avis.titre: Turned my skin around in 4 days
avis.texte: After reading some reviews, on first use I expected this to be even thicker. Formula has a break on the skin but maintains its creaminess while it melts down and absorbs. I'm a tretinoin user and transitioning into winter weather has been hard. I've had this for a week now and by the third day my skin was vastly calmer, smoother, brighter and more even. Absolutely will be repurchasing.

I just got my jar and was impressed with the entire experience. I know some do not like the weight of the jar but I love that it feels substantial and made of glass, not plastic. The cream needs to be worked into the skin and if I had to compare it is a bit like Wewelda lotion or Nivea in a can. It is super thick and emollient. I love that it has no scent and feels luxurious. I returned my l'oréal midnight cream due to the strong perfume smell and so pleased I found this instead. Now I want to purchase the entire line!

I bought this cream when it released and have been using it every night since I received it. I'm in love with it. I have dry skin that gets especially dry and sensitized during the winter months. This cream feels like a thick barrier of moisture that I can apply at night and wake up to dewy, bouncy, happy skin. That being said, if you don't like a THICK and emollient moisturizer, you will probably hate this. I also see what other reviews mean about the smell (kind of plasticy) but this dissipates within a few minutes. I'm extremely scent sensitive and it's not enough to dissuade me from excitedly reaching for this product every night. I've already bought two back ups because I don't ever want to be without this cream.

This new rich multi-peptide cream is literally the most amazing product I have ever used on my skin! I have been using it for nearly three weeks and my skin is SO smooth, bouncy, and soft. I didn't think it could get better than the original multi-peptide moisturizer, but this did it. I want to order 14 more jars!

Was so looking forward to this cream, but unfortunately the smell is unwearable. To me, it smells very plastic/synthetic. Also agree with a couple other reviews that it's not as emollient as you would want it to be. It felt ok for the minute after and then my face felt a little dry and sticky, not dewy and moisturized. I'll be returning.
I love the entire peptide line so I was excited for this! When I use this, it doesn't absorb and seems to separate as I try to rub it in.

I was really hoping I was going to love this moisturizer as much if not more than the plant ceramide cream. For one, the jar is way too big for the amount of product you get inside. The jar is also extremely heavy. The jar isn't filled as much as other creams are so I'm not sure if I got nicked here or what the deal is, but I hate the packaging. The cream itself reminds me of the old formula of Kiehls avocado eye before they updated it, this cream feels like a water-base with a little bit of oil not oil base with a little bit of water if that makes any sense. Upon putting it on the skin I feel a burst of hydration, but then it takes a while to rub it in and absorb. I do not feel as if this moisturizer layers on top of anything very well and you'd better make sure you don't apply on top of damp skin. I will probably be giving this jar away to a friend and not repurchasing. I will stick to the plant ceramide cream, which is the best moisturizer I have ever used.

I just got this and it's so thick yet rich and spreads so easily! It's so hydrating! I'm shocked at how amazing this is. Thick enough for night but I can definitely wear this during the day too in the winter. It'll last a while since it's so thick and you don't need a lot at all. I woke up with dewy and hydrating skin. I always wanted to get the regular peptide cream in the bottle and didn't. So I when I saw this I had to grab it. So now I'll probably get the other peptide cream too now. It's so worth the money!

This product is named perfectly. It truly is so rich and luxurious; I enjoy putting it on. It's so thick and creamy yet sinks right in. Perfect for the colder and drier winter months and I glow afterward. Also a phenomenal price point - really blown away by this moisturizer's performance and absolutely will be adding it to my routine.
This product has SAVED my skin already this winter!! As someone with dry skin this is now my go-to moisturizer morning + night. Idk how I ever lived without it!!
